notes: TDS v1.0 (29-06-2022), Polish-language distributor copy (Kamami) of Prusa Polymers TDS; English official PDF not found. Second print orientation is 'Vertical xz' (on edge, still in-plane) - NOT a Z/upright test, so z fields left null. XZ values: tensile 49 MPa, modulus 3.3 GPa, elong 2.6%, flex 103 MPa / 6.2 GPa, Charpy unnotched 51, notched 17. Interlayer adhesion (Prusa method) 20 +/- 5 MPa - closest thing to a Z strength. Uses recycled CF per distributors.
